Denial of service via slow NFKC normalization of user-supplied redirect targets in django.http.HttpResponseRedirect, HttpResponsePermanentRedirect, and the django.shortcuts.redirect shortcut on Windows: an attacker can supply a URL containing a very large number of Unicode characters to trigger excessive CPU usage.

cwe: CWE-407: Inefficient Algorithmic Complexity
